description: Data-preparation benchmark: messy cases with closure-based ground truth. Synthetic cases are generated by frontier_prep.benchmarks.make_case; real cases name a hub dataset (python -m frontier_hub pull <hub_id> --convert) and run when it is present.

metrics.ops: closure quantity after the designated ops (open edges, force-closure residual, duplicates found, spike step) and bitwise reproducibility of the output version across worker counts
metrics.judges: accuracy / ECE / Brier per question family on the `judgment` fields below
metrics.agents: task completion with zero unapproved runs; proposals until approval; rebuildable without a model by replaying the recipe

synthetic.name: seam_soup
synthetic.defect: every face carries its own copy of its vertices (per-patch export)
synthetic.truth: open_edges == 0 after merge, area unchanged to 1e-5

synthetic.name: unit_mismatch
synthetic.defect: pressure stored in MPa, declared Pa

synthetic.name: vertex_vs_cell
synthetic.defect: a smoothed vertex copy next to the native cell field
synthetic.truth: native cell field closes to 1e-3, the vertex copy does not

synthetic.name: duplicate_frames
synthetic.defect: repeated initial frame per trajectory; two trajectories share the initial condition
synthetic.truth: exactly one frame dropped per trajectory; the shared-initial group found

synthetic.name: glitch
synthetic.defect: one spiked step in a trajectory
synthetic.truth: the spike step is the first flagged jump; clean trajectories have none

synthetic.name: leakage
synthetic.defect: a rerun with identical geometry on both sides of a random split
synthetic.truth: the duplicate group is found; a geometry-hash group split has no duplicates across splits

synthetic.name: naming
synthetic.defect: OpenFOAM names with kinematic units (pMean, wallShearStressMean, static(p)_coeffMean, yPlusMean)
synthetic.truth: canonical mapping as expected; after rho scaling the force closure holds to 1e-3

synthetic.name: geometry_scale
synthetic.defect: points in mm, card says m
synthetic.truth: bounding box matches the metre geometry to 1e-4

real.name: ahmedml-seams
real.expected: LOD 0 was merged at ingest: open edges 0 on the merged mesh (source VTP had 58k)
real.source: AhmedML, arXiv:2407.20801; measured by DimensionLab Frontier

real.name: ahmedml-force-closure
real.expected: integrated Cd within 3.6e-4 of the solver CSV using the cell field and kinematic pressure with rho = 1
real.source: AhmedML, arXiv:2407.20801; measured by DimensionLab Frontier

real.name: shift-crash-units
real.expected: von Mises peaks near 2e3 are implausible in Pa (steel yields at 2.5e8..4e8 Pa): MPa

real.name: trl2d-initial-frames
real.expected: step 0 bit-identical across trajectories of the same tcool
real.source: The Well, arXiv:2412.00568; measured by DimensionLab Frontier

real.name: cylinder-continuity
real.expected: jumps flagged in a minority of trajectories (5/240 in the full set)
real.source: MeshGraphNets, arXiv:2010.03409; measured by DimensionLab Frontier
